results.title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up

results.title: Wagering the Bread Money: Sports Betting Legalization and Food Sufficiency

results.title: The Effect of Height on Adolescents' Body Image Perceptions and Behaviors

results.title: Does Regional Variation in Wage Levels Identify the Effects of a National Minimum Wage?

results.title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment

results.title: Are carbon tariffs climate policy?

results.title: Intergenerational Mobility in Late Qing Dynasty: Evidence from Northeast China

results.title: Is the iPhone Birth Control? Causal Evidence from AT&T’s 2007–2011 Carrier Monopoly

results.title: How Small is Small? Non-linearities in Heterogeneous Agent Models

results.title: What Investment Data Implies about the AI Transition

results.title: Bayesian Non-Persuasion

results.title: Innovation without Borders? The Geography of Technological Diffusion

results.title: A Bayesian Critic for Frequentist Procedures

results.title: Factor Bias and Heterogeneous Output Quality in Multiproduct Production

results.title: Where There’s Smoke: Stochastic Caregiving Shocks and Mothers’ Labor Market Outcomes

results.title: Writing Code vs. Shipping Code: Productivity Effects Across Generations of AI Coding Tools

results.title: Deep-Tech Innovation: A Multi-Method Study toward a Conceptual Framework and Research Agenda

results.title: Towards a Methodology for Measuring Rental Property Ownership in the United States

results.title: The AGI Race and Existential Risk

results.title: An Ethical Pollution Tax

results.title: Deadly Stigma

results.title: Non-User Externalities

results.title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?

results.title: College Affirmative Action and Students' Outcomes: A Matter of the Dose

results.title: AI for Structural Estimation

results.title: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance

results.title: Optimal Long-Term Care Provision and Insurance with Heterogeneous Preferences and Risks

results.title: Does the Import Invasion Explain the Mysterious Disappearance of Productivity Growth in U.S. Manufacturing?

results.title: Beliefs and Stock Market Fluctuations: New Evidence from the Past Seven Decades

results.title: The U.S. Civil War's Impact on Women's Work and Political Participation
